title: Integer raster casts, QA bitwise operations and exact Float64 predicates

entry_inventory.interpretation: Exact-name declarations only, including aliases and limited signatures; not full GEE compatibility or migration success rate.

implementation.casts: Seven signed/unsigned8/16/32 and signed64 targets; finite clamp/toward-zero policy, int64 results limited to +/-2^53. All cast/bit results physically Float64 NaN NoData, not a claim of Google integer dtype propagation.
implementation.bits: AND/OR/XOR/NOT, signed shifts0..63 and bitCount64 over finite integral actual inputs/results within +/-2^53. Left shift never wraps; invalid fixed operands reject before pixel traversal even on masked images.
implementation.comparisons: Six existing predicates preserve actual finite Float64, subnormals, high bits and signed-zero numeric equality. Float32 graphs remain unchanged. Only proven comparison0/1 outputs can safely enter Float32 callbacks; general Double/integer arithmetic still needs explicit toFloat.
implementation.constant_precision: Folded casts/bit results retain a Double marker. Existing addBands grid binding supports exact comparisons of source-bound constants. Raster-masked source-free typed constants reject explicitly rather than round silently; standalone/global constants remain unsupported.
implementation.mask_fix: GeoTrellis conversion could turn valid Int.MinValue with a different user-defined NoData sentinel into NaN. Public local_ee_to_double/to_float now read the original source getDouble mask via ee_cell_conversion; shared copyAsDouble also reads the original source type. Other direct upstream conversion paths are outside this fix and are not globally certified.
implementation.pairing: Existing one-band broadcast and natural-order pairing, names/properties/footprint preserved. Distinct actual raster operands need common-grid proof before merge; no export-grid inference.
implementation.wire: Canonical compact sorted v1 JSON, exact fields, finite binary64-hex constants, one/two contiguous band indices, <=1024ASCII bytes, duplicate/unknown/noncanonical data rejected independently in Python and Scala.
implementation.bridge: Actual cubes require ordered band0[,band1]. Pinned upstream dry-run loses labels through rename/merge; bridge validates canonical spec and bounded acyclic source traces, preserves all dependencies and carries only fixed output v schema. Actual band validation is deferred, not fabricated. Per-call shared-ancestry memo and <=500 roots/distinct nodes.

limits.scope: Native work includes source copies, operand reads/checks, output and bounded operation costs. Admission is not measured throughput/RSS. Snapshot stability across census/lazy evaluation and full distributed resource behavior remain unverified.

warnings.scope: No dependency or interpreter changes; not a new advisory/security scan.

official_clients.map_export: Offline request capture only, no HTTP service or physical raster export; synthetic metadata, not user data.

original_probes.scope: Original fixed50 expressions, not random API coverage.

native.scope: Actual GeoTrellis tiles through LocalEeIntegerValuesNumeric.applyTile; no SparkContext, service, sandbox task, VM, container, or user data

bridge_controls.scope: Real upstream process evaluator covers one/two-source metadata, chained constants and preserved dependencies. Mocked actual-cube SPI forwarding and wrong-count/order rejection; no full Spark execution.

native_shared_copy_regression.scope: Existing trusted standalone numerical fixtures after shared-copy change; complete50-source adapter build.

validation.manifest_integrity: Portable rejection controls for omitted/extra source entries and tampered shared/conversion digests; native probe validates exact all-source manifest, JAR, builder and provider registration.

adapter.build_warnings: Existing image-sample outer-reference warning and9 Scala deprecations, two warning groups.

final_whitespace_normalization.scope: Only redundant trailing blank lines removed from four test files after full regression; preceding bytes identical. Final commit CI tests final bytes.
